allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Sumeet Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on September 19, 2026 regarding allotment of equity shares to Non-promoters on conversion of Optionally Convertible redeemable Preference shares

allot.subject: Press Release
allot.text: Sumeet Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 24, 2026, titled "Sumeet Industries Limited Completes ₹199.75 Cr Rights Issue to Drive Capacity Expansion and Long-Term Growth".

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Sumeet Industries Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on July 22, 2026, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 8 : 25, i.e 8 Equity Shares for every 25 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is Rs. 11.86 per share.

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Sumeet Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding  Board meeting held on March 31, 2025 regarding allotment of equity shares to Successful Resolution Applicant       " Eagle Group " as per Resolution Plan approved by Hon'ble NCLT.

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Sumeet Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding  Board meeting held on December 11, 2024 regarding allotment of 2,80,00,000 Nos. of  Optionally Convertible Redeemable Preference Shares of Rs. 10/-per Share to Lenders in pursuance of approved Resolution Plan
